# Incident triage checklist

Generic synthetic template; not evidence of an actual incident or authorization
to make operational changes. Mark unknown facts as unknown and unverified checks
as pending. Do not include secrets, personal data, or real customer information.

## Identification
- [ ] Record a synthetic incident ID, detection time and time zone.
- [ ] Name the response owner and record the reported symptom and severity.

## Scope
- [ ] Identify affected service components and the suspected time window.
- [ ] Separate confirmed impact from hypotheses; record what remains unknown.

## Mitigation
- [ ] Identify the safest reversible mitigation and required approval.
- [ ] Record the action owner, rollback criteria and validation plan.
- [ ] Verify the result before claiming recovery; escalate unresolved impact.

## Evidence
- [ ] Link sanitized synthetic observations, timestamps and relevant changes.
- [ ] Record actions and outcomes chronologically, distinguishing facts from inference.

## Follow-up
- [ ] Assign outstanding actions and a next review time.
- [ ] Confirm handover receipt and document residual risks.
- [ ] Record a reasoned retrospective and track prevention work to completion.
